tiers.text: 0 of 32 registers have no recovered freeze condition
the flops form 1 register groups; the largest is reg_dfstp_2_11 (32 members)

The 32 flops form a single chain once you look past each one's own clock-enable mux (every flop's D is mux(enable, hold-at-Q, real-next-value); the real-next-value is the interesting input). Three flops take their real-next-value from an XOR instead of the neighbouring stage's Q -- those are the taps, and the XOR's other input is the same flop in all three cases.
